name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is required because Response(at_exit, holding_box) holds vacuously if the exit is never reached. Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures carrying the box to the exit. Response(box_fell, holding_box) captures picking the box up again after each fall, and holding_box can only follow box_fell on a later step, which the one-step fall event allows. All three clauses are hard, match the wording, and are feasible in this environment.

texts: Reach the exit (the agent must end the episode on the exit cell).
Carry the box to the exit: when the agent is on the exit, it must be holding the box at that step.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must hold the box again at that step or later (pick it up again).
